large-title.purpose: One per screen, top left; hero and pop-up titles.

section.purpose: Headings between groups, such as guide categories.

title.purpose: Stage names, hero action label, article subheads.

headline.purpose: Card, tile and list row titles; back links; underline tabs.

body.purpose: Coach copy and descriptions; articles step up to 17px at 1.6, 65ch.

label.purpose: Muted group labels above fields; row sub-lines.

caption.purpose: Tab labels, chart ticks, small chips, weekday letters.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dark theme: tab bar, toasts, pop-ups.

shadows.name: float-light
shadows.purpose: Light theme: tab bar, toasts, pop-ups.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on buttons, tiles and plans; the plus button uses scale(.94).

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Onboarding stagger and celebration text, .32s to .4s.

motion.name: win-arc
motion.purpose: Celebration ring sweep, then a .5s overshoot tick.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion is gated behind this query.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a block.
components.css: .ds-btn { appearance: none; font: 700 15px var(--body); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background .15s, color .15s, transform .1s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent-2); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn2 { appearance: none; font: 700 15px var(--body); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); transition: background .15s, transform .1s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn2:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, var(--line)); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Plus Button
components.description: Fixed round log button beside the tab bar; opens quick add.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Log something"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="30" height="30" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 66px; height: 66px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-fab:hover { background: var(--accent-2); } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(.94); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Five-tab blurred pill at the bottom; active tab raised with a blue icon.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="on"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="23" height="23" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>Today</button><button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="23" height="23" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>Journey</button><button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="23" height="23" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>Fast</button><button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="23" height="23" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>Food</button><button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="23" height="23" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>Progress</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { width: 380px; max-width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); padding: 5px; border-radius: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-tabs button { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--ink); opacity: .78; font: 600 12px var(--body); padding: 8px 0 7px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button.on { opacity: 1; background: var(--raised); } .ds-tabs button.on svg { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tabs button:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grouped List
components.description: More screen rows: domain glyph, title, sub-line, chevron.
components.css: .ds-mlist { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; max-width: 420px; } .ds-mrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 14px 16px; min-height: 60px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-mrow:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-mrow i { color: var(--muted); display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-mrow span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-mrow b { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-mrow small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-mrow em { color: var(--faint); display: grid; } .ds-mrow:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-mrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Quick Add Tile
components.description: Two-column log grid tile with a tinted icon square.
components.css: .ds-qtile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; width: 180px; min-height: 116px; text-align: left; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-qtile i { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-qtile b { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-qtile small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-qtile:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, var(--line)); } .ds-qtile:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-qtile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Tiles
components.description: Fasting-app stat grid: big tabular figure, small muted label.
components.css: .ds-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; max-width: 420px; font-family: var(--body); } .ds-stat { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; } .ds-stat b { display: block; font: 700 28px/1.1 var(--display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-stat span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Guide Tile
components.description: Illustrated insight card: pastel 4:3 art panel, title and read time.
components.css: .ds-gtile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 180px; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-gart { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: #dce8ff; color: #2f5fc4; } .ds-gart::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 70%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); right: -12%; bottom: -22%; } .ds-gart::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 34%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.35); left: 8%; top: 10%; } .ds-gtile b { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-gtile small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: -4px; } .ds-gtile:hover .ds-gart { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-gtile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 18px; }

components.css: .ds-hero { border-radius: 24px; padding: 18px; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; max-width: 420px; font-family: var(--body); background: linear-gradient(150deg, #2c62d4 0%, #1a3a82 100%); } .ds-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .85; } .ds-hero h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 34px/.95 var(--display); } .ds-hero p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; } .ds-go { background: #fff; color: #13306b; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; min-height: 56px; font: 700 20px var(--body); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s; } .ds-go:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Inset field with a muted label above; blue border on focus.
components.css: .ds-f { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font: 600 13px var(--body); color: var(--muted); max-width: 280px; } .ds-input { font: 400 15px var(--body); color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 46px; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }

narrative.northStar: The Quiet Coach in Your Pocket
narrative.overview:
Run Back looks and behaves like a native iOS health app that happens to know about fasting, training and food at once. The world is deep blue-grey navy in the dark theme and cool paper grey in the light one, with white or slate cards, grouped lists, a floating pill tab bar, and a separate round blue plus button that holds every log. The visual reference is the user's own: Lose It style grouped lists and floating tab bar, and a fasting app's stat grids and illustrated insight cards. Nothing is invented for spectacle; every surface is a familiar phone pattern done carefully.

Type is the system face (SF Pro on Apple devices, Inter loaded from Google Fonts elsewhere) in mixed case throughout. Hierarchy comes from size and weight on a short, Apple-like ramp, not from case, tracking or a second family. Large tabular numerals carry the data: timers, streaks, weights and totals are the loudest things on any screen, and the words around them stay small and muted.

Colour is functional. Blue means act now and running; amber is the fast; rose is the body (food, weight); teal is water; violet is strength and cross-training; gold is Premium. One saturated card per screen at most (the session hero or the Journey card) carries a fixed deep gradient with white ink; everything else sits on neutral surfaces with a soft tinted icon square to say which domain it belongs to. The voice is a calm expert coach, and the visuals match: no hype colour, no alarm red except for safety and destructive actions.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy dark theme first, a complete light theme second, both from one token set.
System font, mixed case, eight text sizes (12 / 13 / 15 / 17 / 20 / 22 / 28 / 34) plus timer numerals.
Floating five-tab pill bar with a separate 66px plus button; a left rail at 1000px and up.
Grouped lists with hairline dividers, 2-column tile grids, and pastel illustrated guide tiles.
Domain colour coding through soft tinted icon squares, not coloured cards.
One saturated gradient hero per screen, white ink, a white primary pill inside it.

rules.name: The Domain Hue Rule
rules.body: Each domain owns one hue and nothing else borrows it: blue for action and running, amber for the fast, rose for body, teal for water, violet for strength, gold for Premium. A new feature picks its domain's hue; it never introduces a new one.

rules.name: The Tinted Square Rule
rules.body: Domain colour arrives as a soft square behind a glyph (accent-soft with accent, fast-soft with fast-ink, and so on), not as a coloured card background. Cards stay neutral.

rules.name: The One Hero Rule
rules.body: At most one saturated gradient card per screen. The rest of the screen is neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Mixed Case Rule
rules.body: Every label, tab, button and heading is sentence or title case. No uppercase, no tracked-out small caps.

rules.name: The Numbers Lead Rule
rules.body: Figures are the largest element in their block and always use tabular numerals; the unit and the label beside them drop to 13px muted.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: Primary navigation and the log action live at the bottom, floating, within one thumb's reach. Nothing important is only reachable from the top.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Cards, tiles and lists never cast a shadow. Only floating chrome (tab bar, plus button, toast, pop-ups) does.

dos: Do take colour from the domain: blue for action and running, amber for fast, rose for body, teal for water, violet for strength, gold for Premium only.
Do put domain colour in a soft tinted icon square or pill and keep cards on neutral surface with a 1px hairline.
Do use the system face in mixed case on the 12 / 13 / 15 / 17 / 20 / 22 / 28 / 34 ramp, with 34px large titles at -0.02em.
Do make figures the largest thing in their block, bold and tabular, with 13px muted units and labels.
Do route new logging actions through the plus button's quick add grid rather than adding buttons to tabs.
Do build secondary destinations as grouped list rows in More (24px glyph, 17px title, 13px sub-line, chevron).
Do keep touch targets at least 44px (buttons 48px, list rows 60px) and gate motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep every new colour a token with both a dark and a light value.
donts: Don't use uppercase or letter-spaced labels; the system is mixed case everywhere.
Don't add a second typeface or a condensed display face.
Don't put shadows on cards, tiles or lists; only floating chrome casts one.
Don't place more than one saturated gradient hero on a screen.
Don't use gold outside Premium or red outside safety, stop and destructive states.
Don't put a small label above a heading as a kicker; let the large title stand alone.
Don't use em or en dashes in any copy.
